from: August book, night 1 (Time to Go Home!)
p1: Long ago, Heavenly Father’s people were taken far away to Babylon. Their real home was Jerusalem. The Lord’s house there had been knocked down.
Years later, a new king named Cyrus ruled the land. The Lord put a good idea into his heart.
King Cyrus wrote to all his people. He said, “Go up to Jerusalem and build the Lord’s house!”
p2: Many people got ready to go. Their neighbors helped with silver, gold and animals. King Cyrus even gave back the Lord’s own gold and silver dishes!
Heavenly Father never forgot His people far from home. He never forgets you either. Tonight, hug your pillow and thank Him for your home.
old: Long ago, Heavenly Father’s people lived far away from home in a land called Babylon. Their beautiful city, Jerusalem, was empty, and Heavenly Father’s temple was gone. The people missed home so very much.
One day, a mighty king named Cyrus stood up and made a wonderful announcement. “Heavenly Father has helped me,” he said. “His people may go home and build Him a temple again!”

The people could hardly believe their happy ears. King Cyrus even gave back the special gold and silver bowls that belonged in Heavenly Father’s temple. Families packed their bags with big smiles and started the long journey home. Heavenly Father had promised long ago that they could return — and He kept His promise. When Heavenly Father makes a promise, He always keeps it.
